name: Delaware

agency.name: Delaware Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control (DNREC)

overview: In Delaware, any equipment that emits or controls air contaminants needs DNREC approval before construction or operation under 7 DE Admin. Code 1102, unless exempt or eligible for registration. Sources are classified as natural minor, synthetic minor, or major. Major sources are subject to NSR/PSD (Regulation 1125) and Title V (Regulation 1130). Major source thresholds for VOC and NOx are lower in New Castle and Kent counties than in Sussex County.

permitTypes.name: Exemptions
permitTypes.description: Equipment listed in Appendix A of Regulation 1102, or equipment with very low actual daily emissions, is exempt. Exempt sources must still quantify, document, and keep emissions records on site.
permitTypes.quote: actual emissions each and every day less than 0.2 pounds per day

permitTypes.name: Air Contaminant Equipment Registration
permitTypes.description: Eligible sources may register instead of obtaining a permit; self-registration allows work to start on submittal, at the source's own risk.

permitTypes.name: Natural Minor Permit (Regulation 1102)
permitTypes.description: Construction/operating permit for sources that do not meet major or synthetic minor criteria. Temporary natural minor permits are also issued. DNREC lists equipment without a control device emitting ten pounds per day or more as a permit trigger.

permitTypes.name: Synthetic Minor Permit (Regulation 1102 / Title V)
permitTypes.description: Federally enforceable permit for sources with potential to emit at or above major thresholds that accept limits to stay below them.

permitTypes.name: New Source Review / PSD (Regulation 1125)
permitTypes.description: Preconstruction review program for major stationary sources, covering both nonattainment NSR and PSD.

permitTypes.name: Nonattainment NSR (Regulation 1125)
permitTypes.description: Major source preconstruction review in nonattainment areas under Regulation 1125.

permitTypes.name: Title V Operating Permit (Regulation 1130)
permitTypes.description: Operating permit program for major sources.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DNREC (tpy): New Castle and Kent: VOC 25, NOx 25, CO 100, sulfur 100, PM 100, single HAP 10, other 100. Sussex: VOC 50, NOx 100, others same. Total of all HAPs: 25 tpy.

oilAndGas.summary: Delaware has no oil and gas production. DNREC's permitting pages list no oil-and-gas-specific air program.

regulations.title: Title V State Operating Permit Program

sources.name: DNREC Air Quality Permitting and Regulation

notes: Regulation titles for 1101, 1125, and 1130 are standard Delaware titles; confirm on the linked Admin Code pages.
